count_parameters: count the total number of parameters in a PyTorch model and its submodules
count_parameters_by_module: count parameters grouped by each submodule name in a PyTorch neural network model
generate_parameter_table: generate a formatted markdown table showing parameter counts and shapes for a PyTorch model
generate_parameter_table_with_depth: generate a parameter count table for a PyTorch model with a custom max recursion depth
summarize_model_parameters: summarize the parameter count of a PyTorch model including total parameters and per-module breakdown
